subject: Livestream Payments: payment-auth latency & elevated 5xx — executive readout
messages:
From: Elliot Turner <elliot.turner@livestream-payments.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Anjali Rao <anjali@livestream-payments.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Payment-auth latency & error spike — immediate attention needed

Team,

We're seeing a severe degradation starting ~08:45 PT across our payment-auth flows that route through Redwood's hosted inference endpoints. Key metrics:
- End-to-end auth latency: baseline ~120ms -> spike to ~1800ms (p95).
- 5xx error rate: baseline 0.18% -> sustained 4.5% across the last 20 mins.
- Throughput: observed drop of ~35% on our high-volume tier.

Impact: multiple streamers are reporting failed authorizations and retries — our payment gateway is rate-limiting retries and we've begun to see customer complaints. This is revenue-impacting on live events currently running.

I attached a small slice of server logs (server-logs.zip) showing correlated 502/504 responses; we can share more telemetry if you need it. Please advise immediate mitigation plan and ETA for a fix. We need executive visibility — CC'ing Anjali.

Thanks,
Elliot
CTO, Livestream Payments
[attachment: server-logs.zip (zip, 2.3MB)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Turner <elliot.turner@livestream-payments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Jun 2027 09:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment-auth latency & error spike — immediate attention needed

Elliot — thank you for the alert and the logs. I'm very sorry for the disruption. We're standing up a war-room now.

Immediate actions:
- Karthik (SRE lead) is taking point on triage.
- Marissa will own customer comms.
- I'm scheduling an ops bridge for 09:35 PT (Zoom link in follow-up).

Request for you: if you can share any traffic filters (time ranges, example request IDs) that will speed correlation. We'll aim to provide an interim update within 30 minutes.

I've attached a quick scrape of the telemetry we pulled so far (perf-metrics.csv).

— Vivek
VP, Reliability & Ops
Redwood Inference
[attachment: perf-metrics.csv]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Jun 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: War-room triage notes — suspected rollout regression

Summary of findings (first-pass):
- Correlation between error spike and a config rollout to the model-routing service at 08:40 PT.
- Autoscaler saw repeated scaling events (scale-in/scale-out loops) for the routing pool serving Livestream Payments. This caused transient connection failures and KV cache invalidations.
- 502/504s show upstream connection resets; stack traces point to a new path in routing that was enabled in the rollout.

Immediate mitigation proposed:
1) Rollback the routing config change to the previous stable commit (in progress).
2) Enable circuit-breaker on the auth path to fail-fast and allow graceful degradation while rollback completes.
3) Pin Livestream Payments traffic to a warm pool to avoid cold-start thrash.

I've attached the delta we rolled (service_config.diff) for quick review.

Short timeline: rollback initiated 09:36 PT — I'll post status as soon as the rollback completes or if we need additional escalation.

— Karthik
Head of SRE, Redwood Inference
[attachment: service_config.diff]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Elliot Turner <elliot.turner@livestream-payments.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Jun 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Draft customer update for Livestream Payments — please review

Vivek / Elliot — drafting a short, transparent update for your approval before we send to customers. Below is the proposed message. Thoughts?

--- DRAFT BEGIN ---
Subject: Interim update — payment authorizations (latency & errors)

Hi Elliot / Anjali —

We wanted to provide a quick update: earlier this morning we detected elevated latency and increased 5xx rates affecting payment authorization traffic. Our SRE team identified a configuration rollout that coincided with the spike and has initiated a rollback.

What we've done so far:
- Initiated rollback of the routing change (in progress).
- Applied temporary circuit-breaker settings and traffic pinning to reduce impact.
- Dedicated an incident team with hourly customer updates.

What to expect next:
- An interim update in ~30 minutes with metrics and timeline.
- A postmortem and crediting plan after stabilization.

We're sorry for the disruption — we prioritize live payments during events and will treat this as a high-severity incident.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
--- DRAFT END ---

Also recommending we offer a goodwill credit (10% of the current month's usage) while we complete root cause analysis. Please let me know if the team wants different language or a different credit amount.

— Marissa

- Prepare a two-slide executive readout (impact metrics + mitigation timeline) for the CEO and for Livestream Payments' CIO by 11:00 PT.
- Coordinate with Legal on the credit language in case they request formal amendment.
- Run a quick cost estimate for the credit and any remediation work so Finance can pre-approve.

Keep me posted on the rollback status — if the rollback doesn't show clear improvement within 15 minutes, escalate to me and we will prepare a formal SLA exception.

— Laura
VP, Customer Operations
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 7 Jun 2027 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: Livestream Payments: interim status and mitigation — 10:10 AM PT

Elliot / Anjali —

Interim status at 10:10 PT:
- Rollback of the routing config completed at 09:58 PT.
- Observed metrics since rollback: 5xx rate reduced from peak 4.5% to ~0.6%; p95 latency improved from 1800ms to ~220ms (still above baseline). Throughput is recovering and currently ~95% of normal for your tier.
- Root cause (preliminary): a recent routing config change caused autoscaler instability and cache invalidation on the auth path. We have rolled the change back and pinned your traffic to a warm pool.

Actions taken:
- Rollback complete and circuit-breaker engaged.
- Postmortem will be prioritized and shared within 48 hours.
- We propose a goodwill credit of 10% of this month's usage; Legal/Finance are on standby to finalize.

Links / artifacts:
- Incident ticket: https://redwoodops.atlassian.net/browse/RW-4938
- Zoom war-room recording: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890 (recording will be attached once available)
- Attachments: server-logs.zip, perf-metrics.csv, service_config.diff

Next update: we'll send a metrics snapshot at 12:00 PT or sooner if conditions change. If you'd like an immediate C-level readout, we can set up a 15-minute bridge.

Again, deeply sorry for the disruption. We'll follow up with a full root cause and remediation plan.

— Vivek
